summary: Somerset County, Maine summit lookout with a 12-foot wooden tower by 1920; register says removed before 1932, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Wooden tower, 12 feet, per the 1920 inventory
facts.status_note: Tower removed; no source describes what, if anything, remains on the summit today

events.note: Second observatory on the summit reported in September 1905; a December 1905 report lists a lookout telephone station on Mount Attean
New lookout station with about 1.25 miles of telephone line
Tower lined with matching boards and painted on the outside
First station of the 1920 season to open, on May 7

Register: removed before 1932. Maine Atlas caption: a 1932 photo shows the tower, which was removed sometime in the 1930s. The exact year is not established; 1932 is a placeholder, not a removal date.
Registered September 15, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

notes_for_editor: Removal date is disputed: the register says before 1932, while a Maine Atlas caption shows a 1932 photo of the standing tower and says removed sometime in the 1930s. The removed event year 1932 is a placeholder. The same caption places the tower on 'Sally Mountain at Attean' and dates a 2,221-foot-mountain wood tower to 1908; the other records do not mention 1908 and this is unreconciled. Brief height 3.7 m matches the 12-foot 1920 inventory. No source found describing the summit today or public access. The twelve-fires item is headed August 1907 but tagged (1905) on the source page; the story flags this. Story wording of the 1905, 1914 and 1916 items was tightened to match the source text. Brief record otherwise checks out: gone, FFLOS US 83, registered 2008.
